pages.title: Steppe Mammoth
pages.text: The steppe mammoth ($(o)Mammuthus trogontherii$()) is an extinct mammoth that lived across northern Eurasia, from Europe to Siberia and China, during the Early and Middle Pleistocene.$(br2)It was one of the largest mammoths that ever lived, with males reaching around four metres at the shoulder.$(br2)The steppe mammoth was a grazer of open grasslands, and it was the ancestor of the later woolly mammoth.
